append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1636). RE-TESTED first: no file called stripe.transfers.create, no migration created public.commerce_order_transfers, and the webhook acked every transfer.* event through its default arm. SHIPPED. (1) Migration 20270345009800_commerce_order_transfers.sql, NOT 9610 as this row said: 9600-9649 is the D7 lane and 9700 is the funds-flow column. Table public.commerce_order_transfers with planned, created, failed and reversed, amount_cents > 0, unique stripe_transfer_id, unique (order_id, stripe_account_id), on-delete restrict, RLS on with no member policy, grants revoked from anon and authenticated. pgTAP: supabase/tests/commerce_order_transfers.test.sql (8 assertions). (2) lib/commerce/transfers.ts: planTransfersForOrder writes one planned row per metadata.split entry, net = gross minus that seller's fee, and refuses a plan whose nets plus the platform fee do not equal the order amount; executePlannedTransfers calls stripe.transfers.create with transfer_group = the order id, source_transaction = the charge, and idempotencyKey transfer:<row id>, one row at a time; a created transfer appends a Labs payout ledger line keyed on the transfer id; a destination order writes nothing; a created row is never sent again; a failed row keeps its error. ensureTransfersForOrder is called from recordCommerceOrderFromSession after the paid flip and before stock decrement, fail-soft. (3) app/api/cron/reconcile-transfers every 30 minutes in vercel.json, cronBudget(40), retries planned and failed rows under eight attempts and logs each row over the ceiling as stuck, one line each. (4) transfer.reversed stamps reversed_cents and status reversed; transfer.created is a no-op confirmation. The file is authored only and applied to no database; the owner applies it after review (execute_sql then ledger insert at 20270345009800). TESTS: lib/commerce/transfers.test.ts (the sums, the destination skip, the idempotency key, the failed error, the reversal). PROBE: red on main at its first arm, green here. NOT HERE: the refund (LIVE-623) and the surfaces (LIVE-624).
